title: Source-specific correlation for SOC security services
notes: Rules require normalized fields produced by the dedicated Zeek, Falco, Velociraptor and malware-analysis adapters.
Zeek capture-loss notices remain health telemetry and do not become attack incidents.
MISP indicator publication is inventory input, not an incident. Only sightings in protected-source telemetry should alert.
Service-down events require two observations to exclude boot and restart transients.
PKI and evidence-storage rules require repeated explicit failures; normal certificate and object operations remain telemetry.
Arkime degradation requires two failed health snapshots and never alerts on ordinary capture volume.

stream_rules.title: NDR Zeek Security Notice
stream_rules.description: High-confidence Zeek security notices; capture loss and generic protocol anomalies remain on the NDR health page.
stream_rules.expr: (event.provider == 'zeek' and event.type == 'zeek_notice' and (rule.name icontains 'Password_Guessing' or rule.name icontains 'Port_Scan' or rule.name icontains 'Sensitive_Signature' or rule.name icontains 'Intel::Notice' or rule.name icontains 'MalwareHashRegistry::Match') and not tags icontains 'allowlist:' and not tags icontains 'benchmark' and not tags icontains 'synthetic' and not tags icontains 'e2e')

stream_rules.title: Falco High Confidence Runtime Detection
stream_rules.description: Falco high or critical runtime findings, excluding pipeline canaries and explicitly allowlisted maintenance.
stream_rules.expr: (event.provider == 'falco' and event.type == 'falco_runtime_alert' and (event.severity == 'high' or event.severity == 'critical') and not rule.name icontains 'canary' and not process.command_line icontains 'siem-falco-e2e' and not tags icontains 'allowlist:' and not tags icontains 'benchmark' and not tags icontains 'synthetic' and not tags icontains 'e2e')

stream_rules.title: Confirmed Static Malware Verdict
stream_rules.description: A static-analysis engine returned a confirmed malicious, infected, detected or signature-match verdict.
stream_rules.expr: (event.type == 'malware_analysis_result' and event.outcome == 'failure' and (tags icontains 'verdict:malicious' or tags icontains 'verdict:infected' or tags icontains 'verdict:detected' or tags icontains 'verdict:match') and file.sha256 != '' and not tags icontains 'allowlist:' and not tags icontains 'benchmark' and not tags icontains 'synthetic' and not tags icontains 'e2e')

stream_rules.title: Velociraptor High Confidence Artifact Detection
stream_rules.description: Velociraptor artifact output explicitly classified high, critical or malicious; routine collection results never match.
stream_rules.expr: (event.provider == 'velociraptor' and event.type == 'velociraptor_artifact_result' and (event.severity == 'high' or event.severity == 'critical' or tags icontains 'detection:malicious') and not tags icontains 'allowlist:' and not tags icontains 'benchmark' and not tags icontains 'synthetic' and not tags icontains 'e2e')

stream_rules.title: SOC Security Service Component Down
stream_rules.description: A monitored component on NDR, DFIR, malware analysis, TIP, PKI or evidence storage remained down for two runtime snapshots.
stream_rules.expr: (event.provider == 'host.metrics' and event.type == 'host_service_down' and (host.name == 'soc-ndr-01' or host.name == 'soc-dfir-01' or host.name == 'soc-analysis-01' or host.name == 'soc-ti-01' or host.name == 'soc-pki-01' or host.name == 'soc-evidence-01') and service.name != '' and not tags icontains 'allowlist:' and not tags icontains 'benchmark' and not tags icontains 'synthetic' and not tags icontains 'e2e')

stream_rules.title: Repeated MinIO Authorization Failure
stream_rules.description: Five explicit HTTP 401 or 403 responses from one source within five minutes; successful access, missing objects and ordinary API errors do not match.
stream_rules.expr: (event.provider == 'minio' and event.type == 'object_storage_access' and event.outcome == 'failure' and (http.response.status_code == '401' or http.response.status_code == '403') and source.ip != '' and not tags icontains 'allowlist:' and not tags icontains 'benchmark' and not tags icontains 'synthetic' and not tags icontains 'e2e')

stream_rules.title: Repeated step-ca Signing Or Revocation Failure
stream_rules.description: Five failed certificate sign or revoke requests from one source within five minutes; health checks and successful certificate lifecycle operations do not match.
stream_rules.expr: (event.provider == 'step-ca' and (event.type == 'certificate_issued' or event.type == 'certificate_revoked') and event.outcome == 'failure' and source.ip != '' and not tags icontains 'allowlist:' and not tags icontains 'benchmark' and not tags icontains 'synthetic' and not tags icontains 'e2e')

stream_rules.title: Arkime Capture Pipeline Degraded
stream_rules.description: Two consecutive failed Arkime health snapshots within ten minutes; successful capture snapshots and traffic-volume changes do not match.
stream_rules.expr: (event.provider == 'arkime' and event.type == 'ndr_capture_health' and event.outcome == 'failure' and host.name == 'soc-ndr-01' and not tags icontains 'allowlist:' and not tags icontains 'benchmark' and not tags icontains 'synthetic' and not tags icontains 'e2e')
